newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Solid unit closes down inefficient plant.
newsitem.headline: Solid unit closes down inefficient plant.

text.p: Solid Group Inc said on Friday its subsidiary Solid Corp had closed down one of its manufacturing plants due to obsolescence.

The company, however, said in a letter to the Philippine Stock Exchange that "the closure of the plant will not affect the ability of Solid Group Inc as a whole to supply or services its customers". The plant is located north of Manila.
Solid is the local manufacturer and distributor for Sony Corp and Aiwa Co Ltd consumer electronic products.
A company official said the production line would be transferred to its high-tech plant in Laguna, south of Manila, which was started two years ago.
Output from the closed plant, which was built in the late 1960s, has been slow due to its obsolete facilities, the firm said.
The company said it has no plan yet to sell the property.
